def SphereUnion (C : GeneralizedSliceCarrier.{u}) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (pieces : Fin n → GeneralizedSliceCarrier.{u}),
    Nonempty (SmoothDisjointUnionData pieces C) ∧
      ∀ i, Nonempty (Diffeomorph (𝓡 3) (𝓡 3) (pieces i).carrier ThreeSphere ∞)

tex_content.html:
Definition
[Finite sphere union] A manifold $X$ is a finite sphere union if it has a smooth disjoint-union presentation by finitely many manifolds diffeomorphic to $S^3$. The empty family is permitted and presents only the empty manifold.

Source: MT2007 1. Componentwise implementation of Corollary 15.4(2), pp. 358–359
